purpose: Do not treat scheduler acceptance or PUBLISHED status alone as proof that an audience-visible post exists on the destination network.

incidentRecord.observation: Metricool reported PUBLISHED for items that the owner did not see natively, including LinkedIn/Stories. Future reporting must distinguish scheduler state from native audience-visible delivery.
incidentRecord.correctiveAction: Keep scheduling fail-closed, use autoPublish consistently after QA, and perform a native/provider readback after the scheduled time instead of declaring success from planner status alone.
